Veterans Benefits: New Mexico exempts up to $30,000 of military retirement pay from state income tax (NMSA 7-2-5.13); the 2024 amendment removed the sunset, making the exclusion permanent. Disabled veterans rated 100% receive a full property-tax waiver on their primary residence.

Description: Clovis is an affordable high-plains city built around Cannon Air Force Base, home of the 27th Special Operations Wing (Air Force Special Operations Command). It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, New Mexico's $30,000 military-retirement exemption, very low housing costs, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a moderate crime rate, a semi-arid climate, remoteness (nearest Costco ~100 mi), and hot dry summers.
